hazards.summary: an unterminated string starts at character 29, so Postgres rejects this script and everything after that point was reviewed as string content rather than as SQL
evidence:
scanner: `'open WHERE id = 1;
ALTER TABLE invoices DROP COLUMN tax_rate;`
a single-quoted literal never closes, so Postgres rejects the script and everything after the quote was read as string content
hazards.remediation: close the literal. If the intent was a comment inside a string, it is not one: Postgres reads `--` inside quotes as text
